data.name: Punya
data.gender_notes: Punya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'punya', meaning merit, virtue. In Hinduism, it is believed that good deeds accumulate 'punya' and contribute to one's spiritual growth and eventual liberation from the cycle of birth and death. The name Punya carries the meaning “Merit, virtue” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Punya usually hope their child will grow to embody merit, virtue and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Punya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Merit, virtue.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Punya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
